attribute.description: The divisions of one level inside a place where a number (population or area) is above or below a value, or the largest or smallest of them, for example cities with a population over 1 million or the 5 largest districts

features.description: Points of interest of one category (for example hospitals, schools, or banks) inside or near an area, or natural features of one kind (rivers, mountain ranges, lakes, seas) in a place

hierarchy.description: The administrative divisions inside a place, the division that contains a place, or the divisions that border a place (or both of two places)

lookup.description: One named place, for example a city, a neighborhood, a street, a landmark, or a state

modifier.description: A shape made from one place: an area around it, its center, a part of it on one side (northern X), or the area on one side of it (north of X)

predicate_filter.description: The divisions of one level inside a place that have a yes-or-no property (coastal, landlocked, on the international border, on a river, in the mountains), that share a border with another place or are within a distance of it, or the divisions that border a place and have such a property, for example coastal states of a country

relational.description: An area defined by a relation to places or lines: the land between two places, a strip along a coast or border, or the border that two places share

set_algebra.description: A combination of two or more places or sets: X and Y together, X except Y, or the overlap of X and Y

children_attr.description: Divisions of one level inside a place where a number such as population is above or below a value
examples: cities in Maharashtra with population over 1 million
districts of Kerala with more than 30 lakh people

children_top.description: The largest or smallest divisions of one level inside a place, by area or population

features_in.description: Points of one category inside an area
examples: schools in coastal districts of Kerala

features_near.description: Points of one category within a distance of an area or near it
examples: hospitals within 2 km of MG Road

natural_in.description: Natural features of one kind (rivers, lakes, mountain ranges, deserts, seas) in or touching a place

children.description: All divisions of one level inside a place, for example the districts of a state

parent.description: The one division of a level that contains a place, for example the state that contains a city

neighbors.description: The divisions that share a border with a place, for example the states that border a state

neighbors_both.description: The divisions that border both of two places
examples: states that border both Karnataka and Kerala
countries bordering both China and India

buffer.description: The area within a distance around a place

centroid.description: The center point of a place

direction_part.description: One side of a place, for example the northern part of a state

direction_outside.description: The area on one side outside of a place, for example the area north of a city

children_with_predicate.description: Divisions of one level inside a place that have a property such as coastal or landlocked

children_touching.description: Divisions of one level inside a place that share a border with another place
examples: districts of Karnataka that border Goa
districts in Odisha bordering Andhra Pradesh

children_near.description: Divisions of one level within a distance of a place
examples: districts of Maharashtra within 30 km of Pune

neighbors_with_predicate.description: The divisions that border a place and have a property such as coastal or landlocked

along_coast.description: A strip of land along the sea coast of a place
examples: 5 km along the coast of Kerala

along_border.description: A strip of land along the boundary of a place
examples: 10 km along the border of Goa

along_intl_border.description: A strip of land along the international border, inside a place
examples: 20 km along the international border in Punjab

shared_border.description: The border line that two places share, or a strip along it
examples: 10 km zone along the border of India and Pakistan

union.description: Two places or sets together, for example Kerala and Tamil Nadu

union3.description: Three places or sets together, for example Kerala, Goa and Karnataka

difference.description: A place or set with another place or set removed, for example Kerala except one district

intersection.description: Only the area where two places or sets overlap
examples: overlap of Bengaluru Urban and 10 km around Whitefield
part of Karnataka within 50 km of Goa

state.description: States or union territories, the first level of division inside a country

district.description: Districts, the level of division inside a state

city.description: Cities and towns (also metros, big cities, urban centres)

none.description: The text does not name a level of division

coastal.description: On the sea coast (touches the sea or the ocean)

landlocked.description: Not on the sea coast (landlocked, inland, no access to the sea)

border.description: On the international border of the country

not_border.description: Not on the international border of the country

on_river.description: On a river (a river flows through or along it)

in_mountains.description: In the mountains (a mountain range crosses it)

population.description: Number of people who live there (population, people, residents, inhabitants)

area.description: Size of the land area (area, size, square kilometres)

largest.description: The largest or the most (biggest, top, most populous)

smallest.description: The smallest or the least (tiniest, least populous)

gt.description: Greater than (more than, over, above, at least, exceeding)

lt.description: Less than (under, below, at most, fewer than)

health.description: Health care: hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and medicines, labs, doctors, dentists

education.description: Education: schools, colleges, universities, coaching, libraries

food.description: Food and drink: restaurants, places to eat, cafes, bakeries, bars

cafe.description: Cafes, coffee shops and tea shops

transport.description: Transport: railway and metro stations, bus stations and stops, airports, fuel, EV charging, parking

bus_station.description: Bus stations, bus stands and bus stops

public.description: Public services: police, fire stations, post offices, government offices, courts

religion.description: Places of worship: temples, mosques, churches, gurudwaras

place_of_worship.description: Places of worship of any religion

leisure.description: Leisure and tourism: parks, hotels, museums, beaches, stadiums, cinemas, gyms, monuments

hotel.description: Hotels, resorts and places to stay

shopping.description: Shopping: malls, supermarkets and grocery, markets, electronics and clothing stores

south_india.notes: Five states and three union territories in the Southern Zonal Council area.

north_india.notes: Northern Zonal Council area with Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Wikidata also lists Maharashtra, Goa and West Bengal; not used.

pacific_northwest.notes: The US core. Some definitions add British Columbia (CA-BC).

palestine.notes: Overture has no row for Palestine: the Gaza Strip (XG) and the West Bank (XW) are disputed areas.

middle_east.notes: The common definition. Wikidata lists only 6 parts.

latin_america.notes: South America, Central America and the Spanish- and French-speaking Caribbean (common definition).

instructions.pick_family: What type of result does the query ask for? Choose by the outermost operation of the query, that is, the type of the final result, not by the places mentioned inside the query.
instructions.pick_template: Which description matches the final result that the query asks for?
instructions.pick_template_flat: Which description matches the final result that the query asks for?
instructions.pick_split: The query has the form given in 'template'. Which option splits the query into its parts correctly?
instructions.is_subquery: Does the text describe a set of places by a rule or a relation, instead of giving the name of one place?
instructions.select_source: Is the text the name of an administrative area, or the name of something else such as a street, an address, a building, a landmark, a business, or a station?
instructions.bind_anchor: Which option is the name of the place that the text is about? Other words in the text only give its location.
instructions.disambiguate: Which place does the query mean by the name in 'name'?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.admin_level: Which level of administrative division does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.predicate: Which property of places does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.direction: Which direction does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.category.group: Which group of places does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.category: Which type of place does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.attr: Which measured quantity of places does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.op: Which comparison does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.natural_kind: Which kind of natural feature does the text name?
instructions.fill_closed_slot.rank_order: Does the text ask for the largest or for the smallest?

is_subquery_criteria.true: The text describes places by a property, a level, a distance, or a relation, or it lists more than one place, for example 'coastal districts of Odisha', 'states that border Nepal', '10 km around Whitefield', or 'Kolkata and Howrah'.
is_subquery_criteria.false: The text is the name of one place, with or without its city or state, for example 'Odisha', 'Bengaluru Urban', 'MG Road, Bangalore', or 'Gateway of India'.

none_option: The text does not name any of the other options

source_options.overture: An administrative area: a country, state, district, city, town, village, or neighbourhood
source_options.photon: Something else: a street, a road, an address, a building, a landmark, a monument, a business, a station, a park, or a point of interest
